title: Rendered pins for the erasure pages self-test (#703)
description: What tools/erasure-pages-selftest.php expects a member or an administrator to receive, for the parts of three pages that tell an erased person what stays (the owner's decisions D-016, D-110 to D-113). Each value is the rendered HTML of one region of a page, attributes included, with every run of white space made one space. The test compares the page it is served with these, and refuses a region that is missing, different, or hidden by a `hidden` attribute, a `d-none` class or an inline `display:none`. Changing what one of these regions says means changing its pin here, on purpose: set SELFTEST_WRITE_RENDERED_PINS to a file path to have a run write what it saw, read it, then copy it in.
$comment: Pinned as RENDERED rather than read from source (#703 round 6): reading the source missed text PHP prints into the region, text an attribute hides, and anything added just outside the cut. The test checks each value is a string by comparing it; a missing key fails its check.
